1| package mesh
2| 
3| import "time"
4| 
5| // convergence tracks how long the mesh takes to agree after a
6| // membership change. The tracker watches version vectors rather
7| // than clocks: a change is converged when every sampled peer
8| // reports the change's vector entry, and the elapsed rounds are
9| // what the dashboards graph.
10| type convergence struct {
11| 	pending map[changeID]pendingChange
12| 	samples int
13| }
14| 
15| type pendingChange struct {
16| 	introduced time.Time
17| 	rounds     int
18| 	confirmed  int
19| }
20| 
21| // observeRound folds one gossip round's peer reports into the
22| // pending set. Confirmation counts are monotone: a peer that
23| // reported the change once counts confirmed even if a later sample
24| // misses it, because samples are sparse and absence in one sample
25| // is not regression.
26| func (c *convergence) observeRound(reports []peerReport) {
27| 	for _, r := range reports {
28| 		for id := range r.seen {
29| 			p, ok := c.pending[id]
30| 			if !ok {
31| 				continue
32| 			}
33| 			p.confirmed++
34| 			p.rounds++
35| 			c.pending[id] = p
36| 		}
37| 	}
38| }
